def factor_log_volume_weighted_return_spread(df):
    """Log-volume-weighted return minus equally weighted return over trailing window."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    log_vol = np.log1p(df_copy["volume"])
    vol_sum = log_vol.rolling(20, min_periods=5).sum()
    vw_ret = (ret * log_vol).rolling(20, min_periods=5).sum() / vol_sum.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    simple_ret = ret.rolling(20, min_periods=5).mean()
    df_copy["factor_log_volume_weighted_return_spread"] = vw_ret - simple_ret
    return df_copy["factor_log_volume_weighted_return_spread"]
description: Compares log-volume-weighted average return to equally weighted return over a trailing 20-day window. Using log(volume+1) dampens the impact of extreme volume spikes relative to raw volume, making the price-volume coherence signal more robust to volume outliers while preserving the core mechanism: high-volume days with larger directional moves produce positive spread. This is a raw single-stock signal; cross-sectional normalization not required.
